During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], after the people of the planet [[Valahari/Legends|Valahari]] refused to stop supplying the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] with advanced [[Engine/Legends|engines]] for their starfighters, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] established a '''blockade''' of the world. The blockade was later destroyed by the Valahari [[Ace/Legends|ace]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Tofen Vane/Legends|Tofen Vane]] and his men.
